# OMP Governance Scaffold & Compaction Sieve Armor

> Deterministic governance spine (1,704 tokens), ~43k working runway SNR engineering, and S1–S4 pre-compaction sieve armor for multi-hour local AI coding sessions. Published under Apache License 2.0.

## Canonical Pages

- [Home & Architecture Overview](https://spoon-t8i.github.io/omp-governance-scaffold/index.html): Core metrics (1,704-token spine, 98.7% prefix-cache reuse, 54–74.7 tok/s decode, 584/584 harness checks), Signal-to-Noise Ratio summary, and glossary.
- [Compaction Sieve Armor & SNR Mechanics](https://spoon-t8i.github.io/omp-governance-scaffold/compaction-sieve.html): Softmax dilution, quantized logit margins, 65,536-token partition table, and S1–S4 pre-compaction extractor rules (0 B idle, <=137 tokens active).
- [Positive & Negative Attractors](https://spoon-t8i.github.io/omp-governance-scaffold/attractors.html): Control-loop taxonomy and real incident receipts (secular drift, flag-drift spin loops, self-certifying tests, and false-green listener traps).
- [Projects Showcase](https://spoon-t8i.github.io/omp-governance-scaffold/projects.html): Receipt-verified builds across Saturn Jukebox (1,098 albums, 8,488 discs, max|d|=0 vs ffmpeg), AMBER_ASCII 60 Hz raymarching, CEIS / Secular Drift Crucible (24,000 transitions), and Cold-Boot KV-Wipe benchmarks.
- [Conceptual & Conjectural Notes](https://spoon-t8i.github.io/omp-governance-scaffold/theory.html): Multi-timescale control clocks (tau_0, tau_1, tau_2) and clearly labeled high-level conjectures.
- [Hardware & Engineering Influences](https://spoon-t8i.github.io/omp-governance-scaffold/influences.html): Runtime stack, tri-GPU display isolation, counterparty testing, and community lineage.
